sources.title: Allenby Border Crossing: about
sources.officialityEvidence: The authority operating the Israel-Jordan Allenby terminal describes the route's Palestinian West Bank and tourist functions, halls, and Israeli border services.
sources.supportingExcerpt: mainly for the Palestinian population and tourists with various citizenships.

sources.title: Population Registry
sources.publisher: Coordination of Government Activities in the Territories
sources.officialityEvidence: COGAT's current government unit page assigns handling of Palestinian Authority requests for foreign visitors' permits to the Israeli-side population registry, subject to COGAT approval.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Palestinian Authority requests for visitors' permits for foreigners.

sources.title: Government of Canada: Israel and Palestine travel advice
sources.officialityEvidence: The current travel.gc.ca joint destination page is published by Global Affairs Canada and distinguishes the Israeli access route from Palestinian territorial administration.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Palestine does not issue its own visas.

sources.title: Auswärtiges Amt: Israel and Palestinian Territories travel advice
sources.officialityEvidence: The current Federal Foreign Office page expressly covers Palestinian Territories and Israeli access requirements for German nationals.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Für die Einreise nach Israel ist eine vorherige elektronische Einreisebestätigung durch das elektronische System ETA-IL verpflichtend.

sources.title: France Diplomatie: Israel and Palestinian Territories entry and stay
sources.publisher: Ministère de l'Europe et des Affaires étrangères
sources.officialityEvidence: Current French Government page expressly covers Palestine and Israeli-controlled entry for French travellers.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Le visa n’est nécessaire ni en Israël ni en Palestine ... une autorisation ETA-IL doit être sollicitée avant le départ.

sources.title: NetherlandsWorldwide: Palestinian Territories travel advice
sources.officialityEvidence: NetherlandsWorldwide publishes the Ministry of Foreign Affairs' current country travel advice and its passport-and-visa section expressly addresses holders of a Dutch passport.
sources.supportingExcerpt: No Palestinian Territories visa is required, but travel is always via Israel or Jordan and the traveler must check those entry requirements.

sources.title: Palestinian Territories travel recommendations
sources.publisher: Ministerio de Asuntos Exteriores, Unión Europea y Cooperación
sources.officialityEvidence: MAEC publishes current entry guidance for Spanish visitors travelling through Israeli-controlled access points.
sources.supportingExcerpt: ETA-IL entró en vigor para nacionales de países exentos de visado, entre los que se incluye España.

sources.title: Occupied Palestinian Territory: current update
sources.publisher: SPF Affaires étrangères, Commerce extérieur et Coopération au Développement
sources.officialityEvidence: Belgian Foreign Affairs' destination-specific update was last updated 1 July 2026 and expressly applies the electronic travel authorisation to Belgian travellers entering the territory through Allenby Bridge.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Tous les voyageurs belges se rendant en Israël pour des séjours de 90 jours maximum doivent remplir une demande d’autorisation de voyage électronique (ETA-IL).

sources.title: Palestinian Territories
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation, Crisis Unit
sources.officialityEvidence: Italy's current downloadable Foreign Ministry travel card says Italian short visitors must obtain ETA-IL for Israeli-controlled access routes and details the route and territorial limitations.
sources.supportingExcerpt: dovranno dotarsi di un'autorizzazione preventiva al viaggio ... attraverso il sito
